# hub-usb

The hub's USB serial manager (one owner of every cable) and the port probe that finds which module is on which cable.

## Rules and traps

- The hub is the ONE owner of every COM port. Only hub_usb.py opens one.
- `hub_usb.py` is in scope.json fullWhen: every USB-driven check depends on it.
- The probe skips a port being flashed (`_flash_ports`) and a port in use (cached identity).
